description: Diagnostic-only daemon (no rebuild of protected rug_pull_monitor.py). Queries service_health for rug_pull_monitor last_heartbeat age (currently 615h14m — stale by >28800s threshold). Checks: (1) process still running (ps aux | grep rug_pull_monitor), (2) supervisord config present, (3) log file has recent entries, (4) write_service reachable. Outputs structured diagnostic JSON to stdout. Does NOT write to database. Does NOT attempt to restart service. Preserves protected file invariant — diagnosis over rebuild per spec section 10 execution rules and Appendix A known-broken section. If heartbeat is recoverable via write_service ping, note it; if process is dead, report as requires ops intervention.
